test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: **Why did Sweden decide against having a lockdown in the country?**

options.text: They did not want to disturb the economy of the country.
They had faith in their public healthcare system.
They hoped to achieve broad immunity to the corona virus.

solution:
The correct answer is: **They hoped to achieve broad immunity to the corona virus. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• It is mentioned in the given passage that, **Sweden made the decision early in the pandemic to avoid lockdown in the hopes of developing widespread coronavirus immunity.**

​Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.
